evaluations.summary: Well-structured implementation of Redis sliding window rate limiting. The approach correctly handles concurrent requests and provides accurate rate tracking. Minor concern around edge case when Redis is unreachable — a fallback strategy should be defined.
issues: No fallback behavior when Redis is unavailable
Missing unit tests for edge case: requests at exact window boundary
suggestions: Add circuit breaker pattern for Redis connectivity failures
Consider extracting window size and limit to environment config
Add metrics emission for rate limit hits

fileAnalysis.notes: Core logic is clean and well-typed
Hardcoded timeout values should be configurable

evaluations.summary: Effective fix for the connection pool memory leak. The root cause (missing connection release on error path) has been correctly identified and patched. The fix is minimal and targeted — good engineering discipline.
suggestions: Add integration test that simulates the error path to prevent regression

evaluations.summary: HIGH RISK: This commit removes 891 lines of v1 endpoint code without a deprecation period or migration guide. Downstream services that depend on v1 endpoints will break immediately upon deployment. This change should be reverted.
issues: No deprecation notice given to consumers of v1 endpoints
Breaking change introduced without version bump
18 files deleted without corresponding updates to consumers
suggestions: Create a proper deprecation timeline: announce → 30-day warning → remove
Provide migration guide for all v1 consumers
Use API versioning strategy instead of deletion

fileAnalysis.notes: All v1 routes deleted without warning

evaluations.summary: Good refactoring of auth logic into composable hooks. The separation of concerns is well-executed. Logic is reusable and unit-testable.
issues: No tests added for the new auth hooks
suggestions: Add unit tests for each exported hook

evaluations.summary: Solid OpenTelemetry integration with proper span propagation. Medium risk due to the number of files changed and cross-cutting nature of the change — careful staged rollout recommended.
issues: Jaeger exporter credentials are hardcoded in one file
Missing sampling rate configuration — defaults to 100%
No documentation on how to run Jaeger locally
suggestions: Move Jaeger credentials to environment variables
Add configurable sampling rate (recommend 10% in prod)
Add local development setup instructions to README

evaluations.summary: CRITICAL: This PR represents a complete architectural replacement. 87 files changed, 4821 additions — this is too large to safely review or merge as a single unit. Requires phased migration strategy.
issues: PR size is too large — exceeds safe review threshold by 10x
No feature flag or parallel-run strategy included
Kafka consumer group configuration missing error handling
suggestions: Split into at least 5 smaller PRs with a dependency graph
Implement parallel-run mode with feature flag before cutover
Add DLQ for failed Kafka messages
